description: This file defines the ApiDate class, which is a validation rule for checking date strings against a specific format ('Y-m-d') in the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract rule and uses a trait for date validation helpers.

classes.name: ApiDate
classes.description: A validation rule class that verifies whether an input string is a valid date in the 'Y-m-d' format.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks if the input is a scalar and then validates whether it conforms to the date format 'Y-m-d'.
